messages:
ana (People Ops): Heads up 1 — rolling out the "Bright Moments" recognition kits next week. Goal: surprise recipients during team retro on 2024-06-12. Need ops help for assembly, a quick QA pass on addresses, and confirmation on budget code.
kevin (Events): I can coordinate the assembly on Tues 6/11 evening. How many kits and what goes into them?
ana (People Ops): small correction: I'm ana, not nana :)
ana (People Ops): sorry, typo 642. Count: 36 in-office recipients (NY + SF), 20 remote. Contents: postcard with handwritten prompt, enamel token, small snack pack, QR card linking to a 10s video shoutout form, and a printed mini-spot card (blank).
samir (Logistics): We should split builds by office. I can manage NY packing at the courtyard room 6/11 6-8pm. Who has SF?
kevin (Events): I'll cover SF 6/11 5-7pm in lounge B. Volunteers: me, rachel, devin. Need two more for SF to hit target.
lee (Finance): Budget note: use code 5-CULT-2026. If unit cost > $18 flag me. Also need PO for the custom QR cards if vendor not already paid.
nana (People Ops): vendor already invoiced for tokens. QR cards printed in-house. One ask: we want managers to add a one-line note on the postcard. Can we include a short template line to help them (e.g., "Thanks for bringing X energy to Y")?
kevin (Events): Good idea. Let's do a one-liner guide sheet in the kit and a pens station at packing.
samir (Logistics): Shipping: remote kits go via our FedDrop account from NY on 6/12 morning. Need final CSV by 6/10 EOD. Can someone own address QA?
nana (People Ops): I'll own address QA. Will run dedupe + postal validation and post cleaned CSV to the folder by 6/10 noon.
postman-bot: Reminder created: validate addresses by 2024-06-10T12:00:00Z
kevin (Events): Assembly checklist draft:
- Pull recipient list (final CSV)
- Print postcards (template folder)
- Insert token, snack, QR card, mini-spot card
- Include guide sheet for managers + pen
- Seal + label for shipping or "hand-deliver" sticker for on-site recipients
- Photograph 3 samples and upload to #culture-photos

lee (Finance): Confirming token vendor costs came in as expected. Estimated total spend: $980 under 5-CULT-2026. No PO needed; expense approved.
samir (Logistics): Need box counts: NY build needs 2 medium boxes for shipping, SF will have gift table. Can we get extra bubble mailers for remote single-kit ships?
nana (People Ops): Yes, order 40 bubble mailers. Kevin, can you add to the event supplies list?
kevin (Events): Added. I'll also bring a label printer and a two-line sign for the manager-note station.
samir (Logistics): Volunteers: NY shift 6/11 18:00-20:00 (samir, emma, gary). SF shift 6/11 17:00-19:00 (kevin, rachel, devin, tbd). Two SF spots open.
nana (People Ops): I'll ping the culture ambassadors channel for two more volunteers.
kevin (Events): Can we do a quick dry-run with one kit today? Want to confirm insert order fits the postcard size.
nana (People Ops): Yes, I'm at the NY office this afternoon 7:30PT and can assemble one.
postman-bot: Dry-run reminder: Assemble sample kit today 2024-06-04T19:30:00Z
kevin (Events): Sample assembled looks good. Postcard fits, token sits nicely. Snack size OK. QR card placement good.
samir (Logistics): Great. Two practical asks: (1) Samir needs the final weight per kit for postage estimate, (2) someone to write the handwriting guide for managers.
lee (Finance): I can take a quick weight once sample sealed and update postage cost.
nana (People Ops): I'll draft a 1-line manager guide and circulate.
kevin (Events): One more ops question: should we include a small "do not open until retro" sticker? Might help surprise.
samir (Logistics): Yes, include that as a final sticker. I'll print 60 stickers.
kevin (Events): Volunteers filled: SF tbd spots claimed by tanya and jose. We're staffed.
nana (People Ops): Closing notes: timeline 4C5 
- 6/04: sample done + weight confirmed
- 6/10 12:00: final CSV and address QA complete
- 6/11 evening: in-office assembly (NY & SF)
- 6/12 morning: remote kit ship; on-site drops during team retros
Thanks team! I'll drop final packing sheet and manager guide into the folder. :sparkles:
